SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR III

Salary range:

Job Description
The Department of Transportation keeps the city's roads, bridges and signals running. Its Information Technology Division supports the systems behind traffic management and permits.
Lead the Windows Server team and act as the escalation point for outages.
Administer Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS and DHCP.
Automate server builds with PowerShell and Ansible.
Apply CIS Benchmarks across all managed servers.
TO APPLY:
Visit the city jobs site and search for JOB ID # 714052.
